rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Rapid trigger remains the default on new HE boards; no single flashpoint this week, momentum holding right at its recent ceiling.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Early reports of stem wobble and inconsistent acoustics surface on the new China-made Lumina Brown; not yet a mainstream complaint.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Lineup and stock unchanged at Gateron, KBDfans, Divinikey since the early-2026 four-switch expansion; still the steady mid-range linear default.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Durock T1 keeps building steady tactile-thread interest as reviewers compare it against Gateron Lanes; incremental climb continues week over week.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Group buy closed Aug 12; interest stays elevated as buyers await NovelKeys' production and shipping timeline.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: TA Neo's group buy closed July 17 and the set continues in production tracking, with attention drifting toward newer keycap launches this week.

rows.name: DCS Dolch
rows.note: Sibling set DCS Molch enters its final days of group buy, closing Aug 23; Dolch interest itself holds steady heading into next week.

rows.name: GMK Beachy
rows.note: Group buy opened Aug 18 across Divinikey, Prototypist, KBDfans, and UniKeys kittings; first-week sign-ups tracking above typical CYL openers.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Split/ergo continues consolidating as the enthusiast default, with steady incremental interest and no single new trigger this week.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Alice keeps losing ground to full split boards; still the common ergonomic entry point but no new Alice-format releases surfaced this week.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: 75% remains the default form factor across new releases and most custom-kit group buys this cycle; steady incremental climb continues.

rows.name: Work Louder x OpenAI Codex Micro
rows.note: Resale still holding well above the $230 launch price with no restock confirmed; chatter cooling further as the device settles into scarcity.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Sonnet and Encore continue their pre-order-to-in-stock transition per Mode's Summer 2026 update, with new colorways trickling into stock.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Paper 65 GB still tracking toward its Q4 2026 window; Prototypist's ongoing CYL kitting work keeps steady incremental traffic flowing this week.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE group buy remains closed and sold out; addon interest keeps fading as attention shifts to CannonKeys' next project update.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: Launched the V6 Ultra Hybrid on Kickstarter Aug 18, pairing the Nova Socket hybrid PCB with magnetic and mechanical switches on one board.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: Quality complaints begin circulating over the new China-made Lumina Brown even as XTRFY MK Crystal TMR keeps closing the spec-sheet gap.

rows.name: Wuque Studio
rows.note: No new group buy or Mammoth V2/Promise V2 confirmation this week; the July 26 product-update post continues to surface in searches.
